title: H3794 (126th General Assembly): Concealable weapons

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, South Carolina); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Carolina text (Introduced, 2025-01-28; official copy, https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess126_2025-2026/prever/3794_20250128.htm (LegiScan doc 3085597))
provenance.note: Introduced version (2025-01-28); no passage vote on record. Only the word "and" after item (14) is struck.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Section 23-31-240): Notwithstanding any other provision contained in this article, the following persons who possess a valid permit pursuant to this article may carry a concealable weapon anywhere within this State: ... (15) active public defenders and assistant public defenders; and (16) employed full-time active public defender investigators and assistant public defender investigators.
Section 1 (Section 23-31-240): Notwithstanding the provisions of subsection (A), public defenders and assistant public defenders, and public defender investigators and assistant public defender investigators may not carry a concealable weapon into a local or state correctional facility.
